meta.projection: EPSG:32618 coordinates translated to the area centre
notes: Predictions are copied unchanged from the repository result. Top-1 and Top-2 are class labels; no probabilities are supplied.
Displaying a geographic crop does not re-run the model or alter its original full-city predictions.
Visually hiding a target label does not establish a train/test holdout; the saved results contain no split membership.
Node geometry and street/intersection attributes come from Washington.zip. Full-city network centralities are retained.
Display morphology is recalculated in UTM EPSG:32618; these display values are not claimed to be the model input values.
Several source plot shape fields have physically invalid ratios, so they are not displayed. The source archive remains available for audit.

Source ZIP edge arrays are uninitialized. Display topology follows the paper relations using original geometry and memberships: all-city building 5-nearest neighbours in EPSG:3857; all-city nearest street within 50 m; original plot building/street memberships; original street endpoints; plots sharing a street.
Relations are bidirectional. One undirected edge is drawn per pair. Cropping exports only relations whose two nodes are visible.

This reconstructed topology explains the method; it is not an exact saved inference trace. The current Urbanity helper can include self in k=5; the display uses five other neighbours as described in the paper.
Building heights are not supplied. Extruded volumes are schematic; footprints are real.
Animation illustrates message-passing order, not learned attention or measured edge importance.
Photographs are joined by original OSM building ID. Reviewed archive photos retain the original panorama ID, filename and byte hash; their contributor names and capture dates are unavailable.

The same twelve displayed plots are retained. Every original plot member and every building with a centroid covered by those plots is included; the original rectangle-selected buildings are preserved. Plot selection is not recursively expanded.
Satellite crops are copied by original OSM building ID from the research archive. The original downloader uses Mapbox satellite imagery at zoom 17; acquisition dates are unavailable.
